speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Morning. Let's keep it quick, I know everyone's got a lot this week. Angela, you want to start with the beta?

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: Sure. So, Balcony App 3.0 beta. We're at forty-one testers as of this morning. Two more signed up over the weekend.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Nice. And how's it holding up?

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: Mostly good. We've got two crash reports, both on older Android. Same kind of device, both on Android 11, both crash when they open the camera from an inspection.

speaker: Tybalt Capulet
text: I saw those. I think it's the photo side, but I haven't dug in yet. I'll grab it.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Is it every Android 11 device, or just those two?

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: Just those two so far. We've got maybe six testers on Android 11, and the other four haven't hit it. Could be they just haven't opened the camera enough.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Thanks, Tybalt. What else?

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: The other one's the offline-sync bug Balthasar found. If you edit the same inspection on two devices while you're offline, and then both come back online, one of the edits just, um, quietly loses.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Quietly loses. That's the worst kind.

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: Yeah. He's got clean repro steps, so at least it's not a ghost. He's still on it, and he thinks it's in how we merge the two versions when they come back.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Okay. That one I care about. Offline is the whole point of the release.

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: Agreed. So, I've got the release checklist. I'll own it. And I'd like to put the go or no-go on the calendar for Friday at nine thirty, if that works for both of you.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Friday nine thirty works for me.

speaker: Tybalt Capulet
text: Works.

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: Great. I'll send the invite after this.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Tybalt, anything from you?

speaker: Tybalt Capulet
text: One thing, and I know it's not really beta stuff. Schema Bridge. The kickoff's today, right?

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Three o'clock, yeah.

speaker: Tybalt Capulet
text: So my worry is, if the bridge depends on Montague's Mesh Routing being up, then our inspectors depend on it being up. And we don't control their uptime. If their service goes down at, like, two in the morning, does Balcony just stop working?

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: That's fair. I don't think it should, but I don't actually know what they're planning.

speaker: Tybalt Capulet
text: Right. I'm not saying don't do it. I just don't want to find out the hard way that our app has a new single point of failure that lives in somebody else's building.

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: Can I add one thing? Whatever the answer is, I'd want it written down before anything goes near a customer.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Yep. Okay, let's raise it with Romeo in the kickoff. I'll put it on the agenda, first thing after scope, and I'll tell you both what he says.

speaker: Tybalt Capulet
text: Thanks.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Anything else? No? Okay. Thanks, everyone. Good week, let's go.
